_comment: Shelf-life table for pantry tracking. Days are conservative single values (low end of sourced ranges; report conservative picks; Argon consult corrections Nov 19 2026). null = no expiry for that storage. Freezer days are QUALITY limits only (safe indefinitely at 0F). Raw meat/poultry/fish default to freezer per household rule. Items with unpinned=true await a decision on unsourced values.
